items.plain_english: Now I shall declare another practice, rare on earth.

items.question: How is the mantra element positioned within the seed of desire?

items.plain_english: Placed in desire, placed in the middle of desire, and enclosed in the womb of desire.

items.plain_english: Having made it desired with desire and placed in desire, one should certainly agitate it.

rows.grounds: compound of śakti (power), bīja (seed), svarūpā (own nature)

items.question: What happens when the power-seed nature emits and then withdraws?
premises: She is of the nature of the power seed.
She emits and then withdraws.
items.inference: The verse sets a condition based on the cycle of emission and withdrawal by the śakti-bīja.
items.plain_english: But when she, of the nature of the power-seed, having emitted, withdraws.

items.question: What exalted state results from the power-seed's withdrawal cycle?
premises: The condition of emission and withdrawal has occurred.
The practitioner becomes like another son of Vinatā.
items.inference: The practitioner attains a state comparable to Garuḍa.
items.plain_english: Then, O Goddess, one becomes like another Garuḍa.

rows.grounds: compound of dāhin (burning ones), amṛta-āsāra (nectar shower), dhīra-dhārā-dhara (cloud with steady streams), upama (like)

items.question: What protective quality likens the practitioner to a nectar-bearing cloud?
premises: The practitioner is compared to a cloud bearing steady streams.

items.inference: The practitioner becomes a source of cooling nectar for afflicted beings.
uncertainties: dāhinām could refer to burning afflictions or burning beings; taken as those who burn
items.plain_english: Like a cloud with steady streams showering nectar upon those who burn.

rows.grounds: compound listing duṣṭa-vyādhi (evil diseases), graha-anīka (hosts of seizers), ḍākinī-rūpikā-gaṇa (groups of ḍākinīs and rūpikās)

rows.grounds: describes the vidyā as fully present

items.plain_english: Alone indeed, O Great Goddess, with a luster equal to a ruby.

items.plain_english: If the practitioner mentally remembers even her name.

items.question: What relationship with all yoginīs results from knowing the vidyā?

items.question: What form of worship is prescribed when performed completely?

items.plain_english: But when, O Supreme Goddess, one should worship her in her complete form.

items.question: What vast multitude of powerful yoginīs is associated with complete worship?
